t: Bitwarden for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: The best-value password manager with real emergency access: trusted contacts can request View or Takeover access after a wait time you set.

t: 1Password for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: Excellent password manager, but it has no automatic emergency-access feature. Legacy planning relies on the Emergency Kit and family account recovery.

t: Keeper for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: A solid choice with built-in Emergency Access: name trusted contacts who can request your vault after a wait period.

t: LastPass Emergency Access for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: It works: contacts can request vault access after a wait period. LastPass's 2022 security breaches are a good reason to look at alternatives first, though.

t: Dashlane for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: Not recommended for legacy access. Dashlane removed its Emergency Contact feature and now suggests sharing an exported vault file with a trusted person.

t: Google Inactive Account Manager for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: Free and essential if you use Google. Set it up today: after a period of inactivity you choose, Google notifies up to 10 people and can share selected data

t: Apple Legacy Contact for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: Free and essential for iPhone users. Without it, even close family can find it very hard to get into iCloud photos and data.

t: Trust & Will for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: Popular online tool for US wills and trusts with guided questions. Not built for Australian or most non-US jurisdictions.

t: GoodTrust for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: An all-in-one US estate planning platform: will, trust and directives (valid in all 50 states) plus a Digital Vault for your digital life.

t: Everplans for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: A well-structured digital vault for life admin and end-of-life plans that you can securely share with people you trust.

t: Prisidio for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: A family 'life readiness' vault with a Co-Owner and a Keyholder who can get the vault after a verified death, with identity checks via CLEAR.

t: Casa for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: A leading multisig self-custody service with inheritance included in every plan, covering bitcoin, ETH and stablecoins.

t: Unchained for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: Collaborative-custody Bitcoin vaults (2-of-3 multisig) with inheritance planning. Strong for larger holdings.

t: Vault12 Guard for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: Backs up seed phrases using trusted 'Guardians' and lets you name a beneficiary who can inherit after a 48-hour owner veto window and Guardian approvals.

t: Ledger Recover for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: An optional, ID-based seed backup for Ledger hardware wallets. Handy for recovery, but it's a trust trade-off and isn't primarily an inheritance tool.

t: Proton Pass (Proton Emergency Access) for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: A solid privacy-first option: on any paid Proton plan you can name up to five emergency contacts who get access automatically after a wait time you choose,

t: Bitkey for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons

t: Nunchuk for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons

t: Liana for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: A free, open-source bitcoin wallet from Wizardsardine with time-based recovery paths, so a family member or trusted contact can access funds if something h

t: AnchorWatch for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: Bitcoin custody with an Inheritance Protocol and estate documentation for your attorney, plus optional Lloyd's of London insurance for US customers.

t: Trustworthy for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: A family document organiser with an encrypted vault and legacy access options. It organises information; it doesn't say it writes wills.

t: MyWishes for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: A free UK-based platform to write a will, a 'Digital & Social Media Will', funeral wishes and an advance care plan, then download, print and share them.

t: Life Ledger for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: A free UK death notification service: notify over 1,000 UK companies of a death from one place and track progress online.

t: Settld for digital legacy: verdict, pros & cons
d: A free UK bereavement admin service that reports a death to multiple companies in one go and tracks updates in one secure space.
